findings: The NIRCam single-CAL detector branch loads SCI and ERR directly; the original consumer does not multiply the two-dimensional image by a separate AREA/PAM array in that read/measurement path.
The fitted stellar flux is converted to an instrumental magnitude before the geometric-distortion pixel-area magnitude correction is requested for output.
An arbitrary global flux-unit conversion is absorbed by the free point flux and does not change the normalized residual or centroid when SCI and ERR use the same units.
scope: Inference about the supplied STDPSF consumer convention from its original source. This is not a complete independent derivation of the historical LMC PSF-construction calibration. No additional PAM shape correction is silently introduced.
comparison: Other packages such as DOLPHOT can require PAM preprocessing under their own PSF convention; that does not establish that the same operation belongs before this independent STDPSF consumer.
